```plato

// A gradient that varies radially between a focal circle (Focus, FocusRadius)
// and an outer circle (Center, Radius), in the two-circle Canvas/Skia form.
// Focus equal to Center with FocusRadius zero gives the common single-circle
// case.
type RadialGradient2D
    implements IValue
{
    Center: Point2D;
    Radius: Number;
    Focus: Point2D;
    FocusRadius: Number;
    Gradient: ColorGradient;
    Spread: GradientSpread;
}
```
